decision.condition: Approval binds the exact source and context hashes below. Changes to implementation or verifier require review before affected execution. Actual evidence and a later independent result review remain required.

resolved_source_findings.issue: Static mount and HTML asset paths differed; required DOM/test identifiers were absent.
resolved_source_findings.resolution: HTML uses /app.js and /style.css for the root static mount; app IDs align. Verifier uses actual #auth-gate/#signed-in/#pending-title IDs. Static literal selector inventory has zero unresolved references, including generated job-row.

resolved_source_findings.issue: Request could be transmitted without durable pending key/body, or storage read failure could look like no pending request.
resolved_source_findings.resolution: Initial pending storage is mandatory and read back before POST. Storage read/parse errors fail closed. Receipt persistence is confirmed before discarding pending retry material; ambiguous results retain the original key/body.

resolved_source_findings.issue: HTTP could remain pending indefinitely and stale reads could update the wrong selection/account.
resolved_source_findings.resolution: UI fetch/body handling has a30s AbortController bound. Account/list/detail/command epochs reject stale results; logout clears previous account UI and user storage is keyed by actual API user_id.

resolved_source_findings.issue: PROFILE_INELIGIBLE used the wrong HTTP classification.
resolved_source_findings.resolution: Definitive rejection matches unchanged API422 for PROFILE_INELIGIBLE;409 PROFILE_VERSION_CONFLICT remains separate. Unknown on-disk profile in the browser probe expects actual503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE from the existing bridge/capture path.

resolved_source_findings.issue: Daemonized PostgreSQL startup could fail before PID ownership was registered.
resolved_source_findings.resolution: Postgres is a directly retained Popen child before identity/log/readiness work. stop derives its PID from the retained handle if needed, checks start ticks, uses bounded fast shutdown/reaping and fails on forced cleanup. Reuse requires the exact private ownership manifest and executable.

resolved_source_findings.issue: OIDC request threads/sockets were not fully owned or joined.
resolved_source_findings.resolution: Accepted sockets and request threads are registered under a closing lock; active requests cap at16. Completed/closed handles are pruned with a retired count. Shutdown closes sockets and joins request/serving/helper threads within one5s epoch, raising on survivors and retaining actual close observations.

resolved_source_findings.issue: Browser launch and teardown could lose ownership or hide cleanup failure.
resolved_source_findings.resolution: Chromium uses its native20s launch timeout. The180s watchdog closes known browser/context handles; context/browser close errors fail the report. Private source drift, route errors, unexpected origins/page errors and unexpected console errors prevent a passing verdict.

resolved_source_findings.issue: Verifier assertions raced asynchronous context, lost-response, command and list completion.
resolved_source_findings.resolution: The verifier now waits for exact context values, actual uncertain-response state, accepted command status and matching job row before asserting. Reload and post-restart UI selection are explicit. Intentional post-commit response loss uses actual upstream202 bytes.

auth_session: Launcher calls the unchanged production create_app(Settings(...)) without injected auth/db/clock/transport factories or middleware replacement.
Production Boundary, AuthService, OIDC exchange/JWKS signature/issuer/audience/nonce validation, callback session minting and CSRF/origin checks remain in the path.

Local issuer accepts only the two named synthetic accounts, validates fixed client/redirect/code flow/S256, uses one-use expiring code and consent maps, authenticates token exchange and signs RS256 tokens.
Consent requires issuer Origin and unguessable ticket. CSP permits only the known issuer/API form targets. Both binds use127.0.0.1; this is explicitly not company identity verification.
Bootstrap inserts synthetic users, project, memberships and mock catalog/eligibility only. No new source directly inserts a session, job, command, outbox or workspace intent.
/demo/context invokes production JobService.pre_authenticate and adds only fixed demo metadata.
database_catalog: API Settings uses the non-owner runtime DSN; owner migration and operator bootstrap connections are separate. Four service roles are created non-superuser/non-createdb/non-createrole/non-bypassrls/noinherit and match explicit leading SCRAM HBA rules.
PostgreSQL TCP listen is disabled and socket/data locations are separate private demo paths. Existing source migrations enforce role identity/ACL contracts.
Catalog import receives a SnapshotRecord from the real Node bridge and an IDLE autocommit operator connection; import_snapshot owns its real transaction.
Seed profile is the existing fixed fixture cloned as project ifpmic-local-demo/mode mock and published through actual snapshot/store code. It grants no real device or release authority.
dto_ui: Actual create/list/detail/command endpoints and JobService authorization/transactions are unchanged.
The existing job DTO exposes job_id/owner/status/revision/cycle/workflow/current_step_ids/fingerprint/profile_version; it does not provide title/request_text/wait_reason.

UI renders actual DRAFT as saved/execution pending, accepted as command acceptance and [] as no started steps. Missing wait reason is labeled not provided. Generic list labels are derived from job IDs, without fabricated server title.
Rendered server/request strings use textContent or form values, not HTML insertion. Session/CSRF are not serialized to storage or URLs.
isolation_resources: New code is confined to experiments/ifpmic-live and iteration-02 review documents, outside the frozen H2 source closure. Git diff showed existing API/runtime/profile-fixture/src dependencies unchanged.

Launcher checks qualified Python prefix and immutable binary hashes from the pinned contract, scrubs process/subprocess environment, supplies explicit empty PG fallback files, preserves HOME and binds only loopback.
Private demo directories/files require0700/0600 and reject final symlinks; launcher lock prevents concurrent reuse of one state. PostgreSQL log is explicitly opened0600.
No worker, Temporal, equipment, publisher or agent execution is launched by the reviewed code.
Static source approval does not replace actual PID/start-tick/socket/thread absence, HBA/runtime identity and before/after source/environment checks.
verifier: Browser blocks requests outside the exact API/issuer HTTP origins and blocks service workers. It records only callback path, never code/state/query strings or cookies/CSRF/token values.
The first create receives an actual upstream202 before route abort; retry compares exact idempotency key, JSON body and original receipt. Same-key changed body must409.
Actual401/403/422/409 and the specifically scoped unknown-profile503 are checked; page/route/source/cleanup failures cannot be called pass.

User A has one logical request despite retries; user B has one deliberate duplicate-submit probe request. Final SQL must therefore show two total jobs/commands/outboxes/intents and one per owner/logical request, with zero additions from rejected probes.
Browser evidence cannot establish physical API restart or database row counts alone. Root orchestration must retain actual shutdown/restart and private SQL evidence.

evidence: Only the authorize HTML response overrides Referrer-Policy to same-origin. Strict issuer Origin, Host, one-use consent/code, client authentication, PKCE and nonce/signature checks remain unchanged. Cross-origin callback retains no-referrer behavior.

Installed pinned Uvicorn capture_signals restores previous handlers then calls signal.raise_signal for captured signals. Launcher installs TERM-to-KeyboardInterrupt before issuer/PG startup, allowing Python finally cleanup on startup or steady-state TERM.
Finally ignores repeated TERM during bounded owned cleanup. Any cleanup error raises RuntimeError even with a primary KeyboardInterrupt, so main cannot report exit0 for failed cleanup.
All other five new sources and all18 prior plan/dependency anchors match the previous review.
